summary: Inverness aerodrome traffic zone deactivated and aerodrome closed for controller rest periods at 1515-1600, 1745-1830 and 1915-2000.
text:
INVERNESS ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLSD FOR MANDATORY CONTROLLER REST 
PERIOD. HELIMED AND COASTGUARD MAY STILL OPR FM THE HEL EMERG SER 
BASES. PILOTS TRANSITTING THE AREA ARE ADVISED TO MONITOR CH122.605 
ALL DEP MUST BE AIRBORNE 15 MIN BEFORE CLOSURE
